links.comparator_used: ChatGPT 4.5 base model without guideline loaded (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Expert-rated quality score (5 domains, max 25) incl. scientific accuracy and guideline compliance
links.effect: ChatGPT 4.5 base 22.76/25 (95% CI 22.30–23.22) vs ChatGPT 4.5 + guideline 21.42 and NotebookLM + guideline 21.56; base model significantly superior to three panels (Friedman χ²=18.377; p = 0.0004); differences only in scientific accuracy (p = 0.0006) and guideline compliance (p < 0.0001)
links.quote: While ChatGPT 4.5’s performance aligns with findings, the lack of benefit from guideline uploading suggests unstructured presentation may be inadequate for integration.

design_hint: retrieval grounding via direct guideline integration
